verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs say it supports 200+ Hugging Face model architectures, and it can also run models through the Transformers modeling backend and trust_remote_code. MoE support is implied by multi-LoRA for MoE layers and by expert parallelism, and a community comment corroborates a 'huge model library'. However, the pack never explicitly documents multi-modal or embedding model support. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-modal model support, explicit documentation of embedding/pooling model support, an itemized architecture list.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: vLLM seamlessly supports 200+ model architectures on HuggingFace
